answer: A Sybil ring dies where each identity must post a fresh, non-transferable stake escrowed per epoch: the protocol deducts an ember-priced fee from that deposit for every attestation an identity files, so each fake twin costs real money again next round. A mirror account that merely copies a good agent's votes earns no credit and pays the same fee, and a spiral of referrals collapsing back to one operator is rejected because rewards unlock only after independent peers confirm distinct work. Clone a hundred identities and you owe a hundred deposits with zero payoff.
